create_lowrank_multivariate_normal: create a LowRankMultivariateNormal distribution with loc, cov_factor, and cov_diag tensors
sample_lowrank_multivariate_normal: sample from a LowRankMultivariateNormal distribution using rsample with a given sample shape
compute_log_prob_lowrank: compute the log probability of a value under a LowRankMultivariateNormal distribution
compute_entropy_lowrank: compute the entropy of a LowRankMultivariateNormal distribution
compute_covariance_matrix_lowrank: compute the full covariance matrix from cov_factor and cov_diag of a LowRankMultivariateNormal distribution
